_comment: Official PDFs, held as GitHub release assets rather than in git history.
Fetch them with: npm run rules:pdfs
Large PDFs are gitignored; their extracted text in extracted/ is committed,
and that text is what the verification pipeline actually reads.
Each entry pins a sha256 taken from the release asset digest.

release.note: Private repo — the public releases/download URL 404s. Fetch via the authenticated api.github.com asset endpoint; see scripts/rules-fetch-pdfs.mjs.

assets.role: Statline authority: 48 warband entries with limits, costs, statlines, keywords.
Core + Comprehensive rules, keyword glossary, D66 tables, scenarios.
Multiplayer scenario pack. Verified byte-identical to the copy the extract came from.

Official 1.0.2 errata table — what changed from 1.0.1, NOT a delta to apply. The digital rulebook here is already 1.0.2 (its cover reads 1`0`2) and carries every rewrite the changelog lists, so no layer transcribes it and none should. Kept as evidence: it is what the Keyword completeness check reads the expected list out of, and it names the pages a rule changed on.
Official FAQ. Feeds the Codex and rules-engine edge cases.
Optional Weather Events module: one 2D6 table of 11 Events, and the procedure for generating one. Supplied by the maintainer on release; small enough to commit alongside its extract.
assets.note: No assetId — this one was added to the repo directly rather than fetched from the release, so `npm run rules:pdfs` does not manage it.
